claims: The Savannah Bananas are bringing their 2026 Banana Ball World Tour to Kenan Stadium in Chapel Hill, NC, for two sold-out games against the Texas Tailgaters on April 11-12, 2026.
Approximately 50,000 fans are expected per day.
The venue is Kenan Stadium, University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill.
The dates are Saturday, April 11, and Sunday, April 12, 2026.
Ticket sales followed a lottery process.
On-campus parking is available for approximately $40.
Activities begin around 2 p.m. on Saturday, April 11, 2026.
Activities begin around 10 a.m. on Sunday, April 12, 2026.
